observations: A bicycle stands on a paved walkway, leaning against a metal railing.
Frame is black with some blue text/logo visible on the down tube, but letters are too small/blurry to read reliably.
Front tire appears worn with visible tread wear; both tires look low or slightly deflated.
Multi-speed rear derailleur and gear cluster visible, chain appears dull/dusty.
Watermark 'POSTED BY SAMMYLIVAN' overlays the image, seller's own listing watermark.
No close-up of chain rust, brake pads, or frame joints is provided.
No photo of a working test (riding, braking, gear shift) is shown.

claims.claim: Hasn't been used in about 3 years
claims.evidence: No date-stamped or metadata evidence in photo; purely a seller statement.

claims.claim: Just change the tires and oil the chain then you're good to go
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows worn tires and a dusty chain consistent with disuse, but no proof the rest of the bike (brakes, gears, bearings, frame) is functional after 3 years of storage.

risks.risk: Tires may be dry-rotted or cracked beyond simple replacement cost expectation
risks.proof: Close-up photo of both tire sidewalls and tread
risks.if_unproven: priced as needing full tire replacement

risks.risk: Chain and gear cluster may be rusted or seized after 3 years idle
risks.proof: Close-up photo of chain and rear derailleur, plus a video of pedaling and gear shifting
risks.if_unproven: priced as not working (chain/drivetrain needing replacement)

risks.risk: Brake cables/pads may be worn or non-functional
risks.proof: Video clip of front and rear brakes being applied while wheel spins

risks.risk: Frame or fork may have hidden rust, cracks, or bent components from long storage outdoors
risks.proof: Close-up photos of frame joints, fork, and underside of bike
risks.if_unproven: priced as cosmetic/structural risk, worst case

risks.risk: Wheel bearings/hubs may be seized or loose
risks.proof: Video of wheel spin test showing smooth rotation with no wobble

proof_requests: Video of the bike being ridden a short distance, including braking and gear shifting
Close-up photos of both tires (sidewall and tread)
Close-up photo of chain, gears, and derailleur
Close-up photos of frame joints and fork for rust/cracks
Clear photo of any brand/model decal on the frame
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a bicycle by type, but the seller's claim that it only needs tires and chain service after 3 years of disuse is unverified and no functional proof (riding, braking, gear shift) is shown, so it must be priced at worst case as non-working pending that proof.
